summary: strcpy-style string copy that copies the source string a2 into the destination `this` using relative pointer arithmetic. The destination address is computed as source + (this - a2), so as the source cursor advances by one byte the copied byte lands at the next position of `this`. Copies through and including the NUL terminator, then returns the source cursor, which points at the copied terminator.

operations.description: Initialize the source cursor result to a2.
Guard on a2: perform the copy only when the source pointer a2 is non-null.
Compute v3 as the relative offset between destination `this` and source a2: v3 = this - a2.
do-while loop over the source bytes; continues until the copied byte v4 is zero (the NUL terminator).
Read the current byte v4 = *result and write it to result[v3], the corresponding position in the destination.
Return the source cursor result, which after the loop points at the copied NUL terminator.

unresolved: The class of `this` and the owning object are unknown.
The caller StringCompareCopy supplies destination `this` and source a2; their relationship is only known through the relative-offset computation.
